value.rationale: The mean strictly increases across every length change, but full stochastic order fails at every adjacent nontrivial length due to a parity-induced tail reversal; changing length by two restores the strong likelihood-ratio order. This provides a complete natural neighboring-parameter ordering classification with exact proof and clear geometric interpretation, not a routine expectation identity.
